typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	tblOpicsFXUnconfirmedPhoneQueueStaging_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		DEALNO as string,
		DEALDATE as string,
		PORTFOLIO as string,
		{BROKER ID} as string,
		SEQ as string,
		CUSTOMER as string,
		CURRENCY as string,
		{TRANS AMOUNT} as string,
		CTYPE as string,
		QUEUEID as string,
		{Transaction Description} as string,
		AGING as string,
		COMMENTS as string,
		BR as string,
		CUST_BIC as string,
		{Value Date} as string,
		NOTES_USERID as string,
		PUBSNOTES as string,
		SN as string,
		Block_customer as string,
		BLOCK_REVIEWED as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> EverythingplusBIC
EverythingplusBIC derive(Loaddate = toString(currentTimestamp())) ~> DerivedColumn
DerivedColumn sink(input(
		Comments as string,
		AGING as string,
		CTYPE as string,
		NOTES_USERID as string,
		TRANS_DESCRIPTION as string,
		DEALDATE as string,
		BR as string,
		QUEUEID as string,
		Block_customer as string,
		Loaddate as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		CCY as string,
		DEALNO as string,
		CUSTOMER as string,
		ValueDate as string,
		CustBIC as string,
		SN as string,
		Block_reviewed as string,
		PORTFOLIO as string,
		BROKER_ID as string,
		SEQ as string,
		PUBSNOTES as string,
		TRANSAMOUNT as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		Comments = COMMENTS,
		AGING,
		CTYPE,
		NOTES_USERID,
		TRANS_DESCRIPTION = {Transaction Description},
		DEALDATE,
		BR,
		QUEUEID,
		Block_customer,
		Loaddate,
		CCY = CURRENCY,
		DEALNO,
		CUSTOMER,
		ValueDate = {Value Date},
		CustBIC = CUST_BIC,
		SN,
		Block_reviewed = BLOCK_REVIEWED,
		PORTFOLIO,
		BROKER_ID = {BROKER ID},
		SEQ,
		PUBSNOTES,
		TRANSAMOUNT = {TRANS AMOUNT}),
	partitionFileNames:[($tblOpicsFXUnconfirmedPhoneQueueStaging_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> tblOpicsFXUnconfirmedPhoneQueueStaging
